item.asgard.thunder_iron.lore: Thor's hammer rings in the forge. Strength for whoever strikes first.
item.asgard.spindle_thread.lore: Frigg wove an oath into every thread. Nothing that swings at the wearer is sure to land.
item.asgard.rainbow_shard.lore: Heimdall guards the bridge that burns in seven colours. Run as if the bridge were under you.
item.asgard.mimir_glass.lore: Odin gave an eye for a drink from Mimir's well. Sight in the dark, and fortune in the hall.
item.asgard.valhalla_honey.lore: Freyja's honey, poured at the feast. The wound closes while the cup is still warm.
item.asgard.serpent_scale.lore: Loki's gift is a way out of every room. The wearer is simply not there to be seen.
item.asgard.mjolnir.lore: Thor's hammer. Right-click to call lightning where you look.
item.asgard.gungnir.lore: Odin's spear. What it strikes, it marks for all to see.
item.asgard.gjallarhorn.lore: Heimdall's horn. Right-click to reveal what is near, and to run.
item.asgard.yggdrasil_leaf.lore: A leaf from the world tree. The ingredient of the Blessing.
item.asgard.yggdrasil_fruit.lore: Fruit of the world tree. It feeds the body and little else.
